title: Jane of Austin: A Novel of Sweet Tea and Sensibility by Hillary Manton Lodge
description:
Novels and Nibbles follows three sisters as they leave their San Francisco tea shop and start over in Austin, Texas. Jane falls for a charming musician, who just might not be the right person for her. Alongside the romance, the sisters navigate family tensions, heartbreak, and rebuilding their lives all with a side of breakfast tacos.

Austin Breakfast Tacos add a little swagger to your plate. Three flour or corn tortillas (your choice and a nod to the GF guests) loaded with spicy chorizo, soft scrambled eggs, melty cheese, and fresh house-made pico de gallo. Topped with sliced avocado, a drizzle of cilantro-lime sauce (our secret recipe), and Chili Cheese Fritos for a crunch worth waking up for!

Come hungry…these breakfast tacos are a little Austin, Texas style treasures worth digging into!
